cards.title: Pronunciation, Vowel Sounds
rule: Definition: English Phonology and Orthography (ናይ እንግሊዘኛ ድምጽታትን ኣደማምጻ ቃላትን) refers to the study of spelling-to-sound correspondences, including the identification of silent letters, vowel sound differentiation (short vs. long vowels), consonant digraphs, and rules of word stress, which are heavily tested in "Odd One Out" national exam formats.

In English, there is a significant divergence between spelling (orthography) and pronunciation (phonology). English is not a phonetic language; the same alphabetical spelling can produce completely different phonetic sounds (e.g., the spelling 'ough' in *cough, tough, though, through*). In contrast, Tigrinya's Ge'ez script (ፊደል) is strictly phonetic: each written symbol represents a single, highly consistent consonant-vowel syllable, and every written letter is voiced. Consequently, Tigrinya speakers instinctively attempt to pronounce every written English letter, leading to persistent pronunciation errors. This spelling-to-sound transfer is heavily targeted in "Odd One Out" (ፍሉይ ድምጺ ምልላይ) sections of national matriculation exams.

body: Definition: English Phonology and Orthography (ናይ እንግሊዘኛ ድምጽታትን ኣደማምጻ ቃላትን) refers to the study of spelling-to-sound correspondences, including the identification of silent letters, vowel sound differentiation (short vs. long vowels), consonant digraphs, and rules of word stress, which are heavily tested in "Odd One Out" national exam formats.

In English, there is a significant divergence between spelling (orthography) and pronunciation (phonology). English is not a phonetic language; the same alphabetical spelling can produce completely different phonetic sounds (e.g., the spelling 'ough' in *cough, tough, though, through*). In contrast, Tigrinya's Ge'ez script (ፊደል) is strictly phonetic: each written symbol represents a single, highly consistent consonant-vowel syllable, and every written letter is voiced. Consequently, Tigrinya speakers instinctively attempt to pronounce every written English letter, leading to persistent pronunciation errors. This spelling-to-sound transfer is heavily targeted in "Odd One Out" (ፍሉይ ድምጺ ምልላይ) sections of national matriculation exams.

Silent letters (ዘይድመጹ ፊደላት) represent a major phonic deletion rule in English. Key spelling patterns dictate when a letter remains unvoiced. For example, silent 'b' strictly occurs after 'm' at the end of a word ($$\text{m} + \text{b} \rightarrow \text{silent b}$$) or before 't' ($$\text{b} + \text{t} \rightarrow \text{silent b}$$, e.g., *climb, thumb, debt, doubt*). Silent 't' is common in the '-stle' or '-ften' pat

cards.title: Quick check
cards.q: Choose the word in which the underlined letter is voiced (NOT silent):
cards.why:
**Step 1: Analyze the grammatical structure**
Silent 'h' occurs in words of French origin such as 'honest', 'hour', and 'honor'. In 'house', 'h' is a fully voiced glottal fricative (/haʊs/).

**Step 2: Identify the matriculation trap**
Students often fail to identify French silent 'h' words, pronouncing the 'h' in 'honest'. Option D is correct because 'h' is voiced.

**Step 3: Tigrinya Explanation (ትርጉም)**
'H' ኣብ ላቲን/ፈረንሳይ መበቆል ዘለዎም ቃላት (honest, hour, honor) ዘይድመጽ ይኸውን። ኣብ 'house' (ገዛ) ግን እቲ 'h' ከም 'ሆ' ብንጹር ይድመጽ። ስለዚ ቅኑዕ መልሲ Option D እዩ።

cards.problem: Identify the word that contains an 'Odd' pronunciation of the underlined letters:

steps.text: The 'ch' digraph has different pronunciations based on word origin.
In 'chemistry', 'character', and 'chaos', 'ch' is pronounced as `/k/` (Greek origin).
In 'machine', it is pronounced as `/ʃ/` (French origin).

cards.title: Quick check
cards.q: Identify the word that contains an 'Odd' pronunciation of the underlined letters:
cards.why:
**Step 1: Analyze the grammatical structure**
In 'chef', 'machine', and 'brochure', the 'ch' is pronounced as `/ʃ/` (French origin). In 'choir', it is pronounced as `/k/` followed by a glide (/kwaɪər/).

**Step 2: Identify the matriculation trap**
Students often mispronounce 'choir' as /tʃɔɪər/ due to spelling. Option D is the odd one because it is pronounced as `/k/`.

**Step 3: Tigrinya Explanation (ትርጉም)**
'Chef', 'machine',ን 'brochure'ን ናይ ፈረንሳይ መበቆል ስለ ዘለዎም እቲ 'ch' ከም 'ሾ' (/ʃ/) ይድመጽ። 'Choir' (መዘምራን) ግን ክንብብ ከለና 'ኳየር' (/kwaɪər/) ስለ ዝበሃል ፍሉይ ኣደማምጻ ኣለዎ (Option D)።
